question: Find the first ORF (minimum 100 aa, standard genetic code) in the viral sequence scanning the + strand from frame 1, and output its protein sequence.

files.eval_guideline: Sequence must match the reference; FASTA header must encode strand, frame, and coordinates; case and line-wrap may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Same filename (orfs_proteins.fasta), and both are protein FASTA files holding the ORF translation.
files.strategy_reasoning: Finding an ORF and translating it with the standard code is deterministic, and the guideline says the sequence must match the reference. Case and line-wrap differences are allowed, so the protein is matched by content (by_name=false), since header wording can vary even when it includes strand, frame and coordinates.
